action: Official-documentation audit of GitHub immutable releases as the r276 continuation's monotonic rollback-witness candidate.
evidence_summary: GitHub immutable releases lock release assets and the associated tag after publication, but the immutable release itself may be deleted; after deletion its tag may be deleted although the old tag name cannot be reused. The reviewed docs do not expose a normal public deletion-tombstone readback sufficient to prove former release existence after deletion. Enabling immutability and checking its repository status require Administration permission. Automatic release attestation is promising but was not established here as an independently retained deletion-surviving Chat-readable record.
tested_scope: Public official GitHub docs only; no O/downstream/other-worker semantics; no release/admin/rules experiment; no external storage/compute/execution; no manual attestation; no finite monthly/trial/paid quota; no added cost; no scheduler mutation; no retry; one semantic leaf only.

constraints.conflict_check: role-local cross_field state/LATEST plus immutable own receipt only

continuation: Fresh-bootstrap and exact two-pass freeze, then test only whether the automatic immutable-release attestation is independently committed to a deletion-surviving public append-only transparency record directly verifiable from scheduled Chat without repository Administration, local CLI execution, external persistent state, hosted compute/execution, manual attestation, finite quota, or added cost.
